title: Hard-set Gold Label
description: One labeled example for the hard-set curation seed. JULIUS phoneme set, mora-level H/L accent, accent-phrase boundary indices (mora-based).

id.description: Stable unique identifier. Format: hs-<category>-<3-digit-seq>. Example: hs-polyphone-001.

category.description: One of the 7 hard-set categories defined in CLAUDE.md.

text.description: Raw Japanese input sentence (surface form, no annotations).

items.description: JULIUS phoneme symbol. Vowels: a i u e o. Consonants: k g s z j t d ch ts n h b p m y r w f v. Special: N (moraic n), q (geminate/sokuon), sil, pau. Long vowel: preceding vowel repeated OR ':' — this project canonicalizes as vowel repetition (e.g. koHko -> k o u k o o). Accent boundary marker '/' MUST NOT appear here; it belongs in accent_phrase_boundaries.

accent.description: Per-mora accent tier. Length MUST equal the number of moras in the surface reading (NOT the number of phonemes; a mora = CV, CyV, or N/q). Contains only 'H' (high) and 'L' (low). Accent nucleus is the last H before an L→ tail. Compatible with pyopenjtalk's HL string.

accent_phrase_boundaries.description: 0-indexed mora positions where an accent phrase begins (excluding position 0, which is implicit). Example: for a 2-phrase 5-mora utterance whose second phrase starts at mora 3, this is [3]. Empty array = single accent phrase.

notes.description: Free-form curator notes: reading ambiguity, disagreement with haqumei baseline, dialect assumption (Tokyo Yamanote), etc.
